				    function RadWindowprompt_detectenter(id, ev, input)
				    {							
					    if (!ev) ev = window.event;                
					    if (ev.keyCode == 13)
					    {															        
					        var but = input.parentNode.parentNode.getElementsByTagName("A")[0];					        
					        if (but)
						    {							
							    if (but.click) but.click();
							    else if (but.onclick)
							    {
							        but.focus(); var click = but.onclick; but.onclick = null; if (click) click.call(but);							 
							    }
						    }
					       return false;
					    } 
					    else return true;
				    }	 
				    </script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    function closeMenu() {
        document.getElementById('home').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById("smallMenuDiv").style.display = 'none';

    }

    function loadMenu() { //DOM



        document.getElementById('home').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById("smallMenuDiv").style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById("content-holder").appendChild(document.getElementById("smallMenuDiv"));


    }
    function loadingClosePopUp(validationGroup) {
        if (Page_ClientValidate(validationGroup)) {
            document.getElementById('prepage').style.visibility = 'visible';
        }
    }

    function OnClientItemClicking(sender, eventArgs) {
        var item = eventArgs.get_item();

        if (item.get_level() == 0) {
            item.open();
            console.log(item);
            eventArgs.set_cancel(true);
        }
        else {
            eventArgs.set_cancel(false);
        }
    }


    function doCustomValidateProceedingsSM(source, args) {
        args.IsValid = false;

        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_ProceedingsTitle').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_ProceedingsISBN').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_ProceedingsYear').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_ProceedingsConference').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        var fields = document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_DropDownListProceedings');

        var selectedValue = fields.options[fields.selectedIndex].value;

        if (selectedValue != "Select a Subject") {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
    }
    function doCustomValidateAuthorsSM(source, args) {
        args.IsValid = false;

        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_AuthorsName').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_AuthorsAffiliation').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_AuthorsConference').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        var fieldsCountry = document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_DropDownListAuthorsCountries');

        var selectedValueCountry = fieldsCountry.options[fieldsCountry.selectedIndex].value;

        if (selectedValueCountry != "Select a Country") {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }

        var fields = document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_DropDownListAuthors');

        var selectedValue = fields.options[fields.selectedIndex].value;

        if (selectedValue != "Select a Subject") {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
    }

    function doCustomValidateAffiliationSM(source, args) {

        args.IsValid = false;

        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_AffiliationName').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        var fieldsCountry = document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_DropDownListAffiliationCountry');

        var selectedValueCountry = fieldsCountry.options[fieldsCountry.selectedIndex].value;

        if (selectedValueCountry != "Select a Country") {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        var fields = document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_DropDownListAffiliation');

        var selectedValue = fields.options[fields.selectedIndex].value;

        if (selectedValue != "Select a Subject") {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
    }
    function doCustomValidateSM(source, args) {

        args.IsValid = false;

        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_PaperTitle').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_PaperAuthor').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        if (document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_PaperAffiliation').value.length > 0) {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
        var fields = document.getElementById('MasterPageHeader_SmallMenu_DropDownListPaperField');

        var selectedValue = fields.options[fields.selectedIndex].value;

        if (selectedValue != "Select a Subject") {
            args.IsValid = true;
        }
    }



</script>

<script type="text/javascript">


                        function loadingCollapseMenu(validationGroup) { //DOM


                            if (Page_ClientValidate(validationGroup)) {
                                var menu = $find("ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1");
                                menu.close();
                                document.getElementById('prepage').style.visibility = 'visible';
                            }


                        }

                        function OnClientItemClicking(sender, eventArgs) {
                            var item = eventArgs.get_item();

                            if (item.get_level() == 0) {
                                item.open();
                                console.log(item);
                                eventArgs.set_cancel(true);


                            }
                            else {
                                eventArgs.set_cancel(false);
                            }
                        }


                        function doCustomValidateProceedings(source, args) {
                            args.IsValid = false;

                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i2_ctl00_ProceedingsTitle').value.length > 0) {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }
                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i2_ctl00_ProceedingsISBN').value.length > 0) {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }
                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i2_ctl00_ProceedingsYear').value.length > 0) {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }
                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i2_ctl00_ProceedingsConference').value.length > 0) {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }
                            var fields = document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i2_ctl00_DropDownListProceedings');

                            var selectedValue = fields.options[fields.selectedIndex].value;

                            if (selectedValue != "Select a Subject") {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }


                        }
                        function doCustomValidateAuthors(source, args) {
                            args.IsValid = false;

                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i6_ctl00_AuthorsName').value.length > 0) {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }
                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i6_ctl00_AuthorsAffiliation').value.length > 0) {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }
                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i6_ctl00_AuthorsConference').value.length > 0) {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }


                            var fieldsCountry = document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i6_ctl00_DropDownListAuthorsCountries');

                            var selectedValueCountry = fieldsCountry.options[fieldsCountry.selectedIndex].value;

                            if (selectedValueCountry != "Select a Country") {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }


                            var fields = document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i6_ctl00_DropDownListAuthors');

                            var selectedValue = fields.options[fields.selectedIndex].value;

                            if (selectedValue != "Select a Subject") {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }
                        }

                        function doCustomValidateAffiliation(source, args) {

                            args.IsValid = false;

                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i8_ctl00_AffiliationName').value.length > 0) {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }

                            var fieldsCountry = document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i8_ctl00_DropDownListAffiliationCountry');

                            var selectedValueCountry = fieldsCountry.options[fieldsCountry.selectedIndex].value;

                            if (selectedValueCountry != "Select a Country") {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }

                            var fields = document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i8_ctl00_DropDownListAffiliation');

                            var selectedValue = fields.options[fields.selectedIndex].value;

                            if (selectedValue != "Select a Subject") {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }
                        }
                        function doCustomValidate(source, args) {

                            args.IsValid = false;

                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i3_ctl00_PaperTitle').value.length > 0) {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }
                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i3_ctl00_PaperAuthor').value.length > 0) {
                                args.IsValid = true;
                            }
                            if (document.getElementById('ctl00_MasterPageHeader_RadMenu1_i3_ctl00_PaperAffiliation').value.length > 0) {

<script type="text/javascript">
                (function (global, undefined) {
                    var rotators = {};

                    function horizontalRotator_load(sender, args) {
                        rotators.horizontalRotator = sender;
                        startRotator(this, 'horizontalRotator', Telerik.Web.UI.RotatorScrollDirection.Left);
                    }
                    function verticalRotator_load(sender, args) {
                        rotators.verticalRotator = sender;
                    }

                    function startRotator(clickedButton, rotatorType, direction) {
                        var rotator = getRotatorByType(rotatorType);
                        if (!rotator.autoIntervalID) {
                            togglePlayButtons(clickedButton, rotator);
                            rotator.autoIntervalID = window.setInterval(function () {
                                rotator.showNext(direction);
                            }, rotator.get_frameDuration());
                        }
                    }

                    function stopRotator(clickedButton, rotatorType) {
                        var rotator = getRotatorByType(rotatorType);
                        if (rotator.autoIntervalID) {
                            togglePlayButtons(clickedButton, rotator)
                            window.clearInterval(rotator.autoIntervalID);
                            rotator.autoIntervalID = null;
                        }
                    }

                    function showNextItem(clickedButton, rotatorType, direction) {
                        var rotator = getRotatorByType(rotatorType);
                        rotator.showNext(direction);
                    }

                    function togglePlayButtons(clickedButton) {
                        var jQuery = $telerik.$;
                        var button = jQuery(clickedButton);
                        var className = button.attr("class");
                        var altClassName = className == "start" ? "stop" : "start";

                        button.removeClass();
                        button.addClass(className + "Selected");

                        var altButton = findSiblingButtonByClassName(clickedButton, altClassName + "Selected");
                        if (altButton) {
                            altButton.removeClass();
                            altButton.addClass(altClassName);
                        }
                    }

                    function getRotatorByType(rotatorType) {
                        return rotators[rotatorType];
                    }
                    function findSiblingButtonByClassName(buttonInstance, className) {
                        var ulElement = $telerik.$(buttonInstance).parent().parent();

                        return ulElement && ulElement.find("li a." + className);
                    }

                    global.horizontalRotator_load = horizontalRotator_load;
                    global.verticalRotator_load = verticalRotator_load;
                    global.stopRotator = stopRotator;
                    global.startRotator = startRotator;
                    global.showNextItem = showNextItem;
                })(window);
            </script>

<script language="JavaScript" type="text/javascript">



         function clearPreloadPage() { //DOM

             if (document.getElementById) {
                 document.getElementById('prepage').style.visibility = 'hidden';
             } else {
                 if (document.layers) { //NS4
                     document.prepage.visibility = 'hidden';
                 }
                 else { //IE4
                     document.all.prepage.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                 }
             }
         }

         function showUnloadPage() { //DOM
             if (document.getElementById) {
                 document.getElementById('prepage').style.visibility = 'visible';
                 //alert(document.getElementById('prepage').style.visibility);
             } else {
                 if (document.layers) { //NS4
                     document.prepage.visibility = 'visible';
                 }
                 else { //IE4
                     document.all.prepage.style.visibility = 'visible';
                 }
             }
         }

         var showToolTips = false;
         var senderAux;
         function closeRadToolTips(sender, args) {
             showToolTips = false;
             senderAux = sender;
         }

         function showRadToolTips(sender, args) {
             showToolTips = true;
             senderAux = sender;

             window.scrollTo(0, 0);
         }

         function keydownCloseRadToolTip(event) {
             if (showToolTips) {
                 if (event.keyCode == 27) {

                     if (senderAux.get_id().indexOf("RadWindow") > -1) {
                         //radwindows
                         senderAux.close();
                     }
                     else {

                         //radtooltips
                         senderAux.hide();
                     }
                 }
             }
         }


    </script>
